name: ColorField
summary: Edits a whole color value as text.

useWhen: Typing or pasting an exact color value
avoidWhen: Dragging to adjust a color; use ColorArea or ColorSlider

obligations: Relate the label, description, and error to the input.
Expose invalid, disabled, and read-only state.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled color strings are supported.
ColorField edits the whole color as one text value and has no channel or color-space props.
Invalid color strings are rejected before rendering.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
A null value is controlled and empty, and onChange reports null when the field is cleared; undefined leaves the value uncontrolled.
errorMessage is shown only while the field is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed validation.
errorMessage replaces the default message and never makes the field invalid by itself.
A typed color is applied when the field loses focus or when Enter is pressed, and Enter still submits the form.

onChange emits a CSS string in the color space of the value, an enclosing ColorPicker's color, or defaultValue: rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex and RGB, hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for HSL and HSB, and rgba() with none of them. The displayed and submitted form value is uppercase hex (#RRGGBB) whatever the space.
accessibility: Relate the label, description, and error to the input.
Expose invalid, disabled, and read-only state.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
